---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(
  rio,
  here,
  tidyverse,
  flexdashboard,
  knitr,
  kableExtra,
  scales
)

nhanes_df <- import(here("data", "cleaned", "cleaned_NHANES.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = if_else(
      rowSums(!is.na(cbind(systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2, systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4))) == 0,
      NA_real_,
      rowMeans(cbind(systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2, systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
```

Row {data-height=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Age distribution of NHANES participants

```{r age-plot}
ggplot(nhanes_df, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0, closed = "left", colour = "white") +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Number of participants") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Participants aged 21 or older

```{r gauge-21plus}
pct_21 <- mean(nhanes_df$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

gauge(round(pct_21, 1), min = 0, max = 100, symbol = "%",
      gaugeSectors(success = c(60, 100), warning = c(30, 59.9), danger = c(0, 29.9)))
```


### Average systolic BP above 120 mm Hg

```{r value-sbp}
pct_sbp <- mean(nhanes_df$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

valueBox(paste0(round(pct_sbp, 1), "%"),
         caption = "of participants with a measured average systolic BP above 120 mm Hg",
         icon = "fa-heartbeat", color = "danger")

```
